dmPFC is a broad non-orbital medial superior-frontal proxy; pre-SMA is anterior AAL SMA without the Ji patient-specific superficial restriction or connectivity target. Other named regions remain gross-anatomical parcel unions.
Study-specific targets, patient electrodes, electric fields, tractograms and exact treatment masks remain unavailable.
Uncertain right bitemporofrontal/bifrontal name remains unresolved. VLPFC mechanistic evidence is not clinical efficacy evidence.
The existing 11 population tract files are unchanged; preset families are not endpoint-filtered to the stimulation target. Bilateral reference tracts do not imply bilateral treatment.

Hyperdirect pre-SMA–STN, exact Jimenez ALIC–OFC, right-insula–left-DLPFC and complete indirect DLPFC–sgACC route geometry is unavailable in this build. C_FP shows only the frontoparietal cingulum segment.

Seguin 2026 was reviewed at abstract/data-availability level; route geometry and full subscription text were not reproduced. Functional and healthy-volunteer mechanistic findings do not establish clinical tract-specific efficacy.
Hover describes population reference anatomy or original point metadata; it does not infer patient-specific activation. Touch input retains tap/rotate behavior rather than persistent desktop hover.
